facts.business: GEM Enviro Management Limited is a sustainability solution organization providing EPR compliance management, waste channelization, ESG infrastructure, ESG consulting, and technology-driven platforms for waste management and sustainability reporting.
key_risks: Regulatory transformation with the introduction of EPRETP by CPCB altering operating environment
Reduction in business volumes and pressure on profit margins due to shift from certificate facilitation to exchange-based trading
Material impact on core business model of EPR compliance and certificate facilitation
